title: Isolation and Phenotyping of Adult Mouse Microglial Cells
author: Kathleen Grabert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnrbmd2n
materials: Resuspend cells in fluorophore-conjugated antibodies for the protein of interest (here CD11b, CD45, F4/80) for 00:20:00 in the dark at Room temperature ( see Note 12 ).

steps.title: Perfuse mice transcardially
steps.instruction: Perfuse each animal transcardially with physiological saline at 10 mL /min until the exudate runs clear (see Note 2).

steps.title: Dissect brain into HBSS
steps.instruction: Remove the brain and place it in a 50 mL Falcon tube containing 10 mL HBSS; the tissue may be whole brain, a hemisphere, or a specific region.

steps.title: Finely mince tissue
steps.instruction: Finely mince the brain tissue with a round‑edge blade scalpel to allow rapid cooling.

steps.title: Centrifuge minced tissue
steps.instruction: Spin the minced tissue at 400 × g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes; aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Add enzyme cocktail
steps.instruction: Add enzyme cocktail to the minced tissue: 10 mL for whole brain or 5 mL for a hemisphere/region (see Note 3).

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue at 37 °C for 1 hour (01:00:00) under gentle rotation (see Note 4).

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Transfer the digested tissue to a 15 mL Dounce homogenizer and dissociate on ice with 20 passes using the large‑clearance pestle (see Note 5).

steps.title: Dilute with FBS
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized cell suspension to an equal volume of 10 % FBS.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑FBS
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 × g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes (no brake) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in Percoll
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 35 % Percoll: 16 mL for whole brain or 8 mL for a hemisphere/region (see Note 6).

steps.title: Split whole‑brain suspension
steps.instruction: If the sample is whole brain, split the 16 mL suspension into two 8 mL aliquots.

steps.title: Overlay with HBSS
steps.instruction: Carefully overlay each sample with 5 mL 1× HBSS and let the tubes rest on ice for 5 minutes (00:05:00) (see Note 7).

steps.title: Density‑gradient centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the samples at 800 × g, 4 °C, for 45 minutes (no brake); distinct layers become visible (see Fig. 1).

steps.title: Collect cell pellet
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant together with the myelin layer, leaving only the pelleted mixed brain cells.

steps.title: Wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 1 mL 1× HBSS, then transfer it into a new tube containing 4 mL 1× HBSS.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at 400 × g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend for magnetic labeling
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 90 µL separation buffer in a microtube.

steps.title: Add anti‑CD11b beads
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL anti‑CD11b MicroBeads and incubate the mixture for 15 minutes (00:15:00) at 4 °C with gentle rotation (see Note 8).

steps.title: Prepare magnetic columns
steps.instruction: Place LS single‑use columns in a magnetic separator and wash each column with 3 mL separation buffer (first wash).

steps.title: Load bead‑cell suspension
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL separation buffer to the bead‑cell suspension, apply the mixture onto the LS column, and collect the flow‑through (see Note 9).

steps.title: Wash magnetic columns
steps.instruction: Wash the column three consecutive times with 3 mL separation buffer (see Note 10).

steps.title: Elute bead‑bound microglia
steps.instruction: Remove the LS column from the magnet, place it into a 15 mL tube, add 5 mL separation buffer, and flush out the bead‑bound microglial cells by firmly pushing the plunger.

steps.title: Pellet purified cells
steps.instruction: Pellet the eluted cells at 400 × g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Resuspend purified microglia in flow cytometry buffer and incubate with 1 µg/mL anti‑mouse CD16/CD32 for 20 minutes (00:20:00) at room temperature (see Note 11).

steps.title: Wash after blocking
steps.instruction: Spin at 400 × g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final cell wash
steps.instruction: Wash the cells for 5 minutes (00:05:00) at 400 × g, 4 °C, then resuspend them in an appropriate volume of flow cytometry buffer.
